name: Ruggins
source:
Ruggins – is a character in Heralds of the Avirentes - Ch. 1 Wings of Change.
Ruggins is a young dark-green blue-eyed om'verai, wearing an eye masks, typical for Nental. Ruggins wears a darker mouth band, covering her nose, too. Belly plates are black and nose is covered with spikes. Ruggins have 3 crown-like spikes on each of her cheeks and dark-green wing membranes.

Despite of being adult, Ruggins has a childish voice.

Ruggins is similar to Elveos in terms of personality, but stronger - thanks to nental training, as well as much smarter. Ruggins is a quiet good intimidating leader, though it is hard for her to keep her team full. Good in om'verai anatomy and weak points. Has a habit to teach weaker foes lessons, has a bad mouth and a good actor.
